    --list-subs                      --print automatic_captions_table --print subtitles_table
    

#### Redundant options

While these options are redundant, they are still expected to be used due to their ease of use
    
    
    --get-description                --print description
    --get-duration                   --print duration_string
    --get-filename                   --print filename
    --get-format                     --print format
    --get-id                         --print id
    --get-thumbnail                  --print thumbnail
    -e, --get-title                  --print title
    -g, --get-url                    --print urls
    --match-title REGEX              --match-filters "title ~= (?i)REGEX"
    --reject-title REGEX             --match-filters "title !~= (?i)REGEX"
    --min-views COUNT                --match-filters "view_count >=? COUNT"
    --max-views COUNT                --match-filters "view_count <=? COUNT"
    --break-on-reject                Use --break-match-filters
    --user-agent UA                  --add-headers "User-Agent:UA"
    --referer URL                    --add-headers "Referer:URL"
    --playlist-start NUMBER          -I NUMBER:
    --playlist-end NUMBER            -I :NUMBER
    --playlist-reverse               -I ::-1
    --no-playlist-reverse            Default
    --no-colors                      --color no_color
    

#### Not recommended

While these options still work, their use is not recommended since there are other alternatives to achieve the same
    
    
    --force-generic-extractor        --ies generic,default
    --exec-before-download CMD       --exec "before_dl:CMD"
    --no-exec-before-download        --no-exec
    --all-formats                    -f all
    --all-subs                       --sub-langs all --write-subs
    --print-json                     -j --no-simulate
    --autonumber-size NUMBER         Use string formatting, e.g. %(autonumber)03d
    --autonumber-start NUMBER        Use internal field formatting like %(autonumber+NUMBER)s
    --id                             -o "%(id)s.%(ext)s"
    --metadata-from-title FORMAT     --parse-metadata "%(title)s:FORMAT"
    --hls-prefer-native              --downloader "m3u8:native"
    --hls-prefer-ffmpeg              --downloader "m3u8:ffmpeg"
    --list-formats-old               --compat-options list-formats (Alias: --no-list-formats-as-table)
    --list-formats-as-table          --compat-options -list-formats [Default]
    --geo-bypass                     --xff "default"
    --no-geo-bypass                  --xff "never"
    --geo-bypass-country CODE        --xff CODE
    --geo-bypass-ip-block IP_BLOCK   --xff IP_BLOCK
    

#### Developer options

These options are not intended to be used by the end-user
    
    
    --test                           Download only part of video for testing extractors
    --load-pages                     Load pages dumped by --write-pages
    --allow-unplayable-formats       List unplayable formats also
    --no-allow-unplayable-formats    Default
    

#### Old aliases

These are aliases that are no longer documented for various reasons
    
    
    --clean-infojson                 --clean-info-json
    --force-write-download-archive   --force-write-archive
    --no-clean-infojson              --no-clean-info-json
    --no-split-tracks                --no-split-chapters
    --no-write-srt                   --no-write-subs
    --prefer-unsecure                --prefer-insecure
    --rate-limit RATE                --limit-rate RATE
    --split-tracks                   --split-chapters
    --srt-lang LANGS                 --sub-langs LANGS
    --trim-file-names LENGTH         --trim-filenames LENGTH
    --write-srt                      --write-subs
    --yes-overwrites                 --force-overwrites
    

#### Sponskrub Options

Support for [SponSkrub](https://github.com/faissaloo/SponSkrub) has been removed in favor of the `--sponsorblock` options
    
    
    --sponskrub                      --sponsorblock-mark all
    --no-sponskrub                   --no-sponsorblock
    --sponskrub-cut                  --sponsorblock-remove all
    --no-sponskrub-cut               --sponsorblock-remove -all
    --sponskrub-force                Not applicable
    --no-sponskrub-force             Not applicable
    --sponskrub-location             Not applicable
    --sponskrub-args                 Not applicable
    

#### No longer supported

These options may no longer work as intended
    
    
    --prefer-avconv                  avconv is not officially supported by yt-dlp (Alias: --no-prefer-ffmpeg)
    --prefer-ffmpeg                  Default (Alias: --no-prefer-avconv)
    -C, --call-home                  Not implemented
    --no-call-home                   Default
    --include-ads                    No longer supported
    --no-include-ads                 Default
    --write-annotations              No supported site has annotations now
    --no-write-annotations           Default
    --avconv-location                Removed alias for --ffmpeg-location
    --cn-verification-proxy URL      Removed alias for --geo-verification-proxy URL
    --dump-headers                   Removed alias for --print-traffic
    --dump-intermediate-pages        Removed alias for --dump-pages
    --youtube-skip-dash-manifest     Removed alias for --extractor-args "youtube:skip=dash" (Alias: --no-youtube-include-dash-manifest)
    --youtube-skip-hls-manifest      Removed alias for --extractor-args "youtube:skip=hls" (Alias: --no-youtube-include-hls-manifest)
    --youtube-include-dash-manifest  Default (Alias: --no-youtube-skip-dash-manifest)
    --youtube-include-hls-manifest   Default (Alias: --no-youtube-skip-hls-manifest)
    --youtube-print-sig-code         Removed testing functionality
    --dump-user-agent                No longer supported
    --xattr-set-filesize             No longer supported
    --compat-options seperate-video-versions  No longer needed
    --compat-options no-youtube-prefer-utc-upload-date  No longer supported
    

#### Removed

These options were deprecated since 2014 and have now been entirely removed
    
    
    -A, --auto-number                -o "%(autonumber)s-%(id)s.%(ext)s"
    -t, -l, --title, --literal       -o "%(title)s-%(id)s.%(ext)s"

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site

### EDIT: This is fixed in the latest release. Update!

* * *

Executable users:
    
    
    yt-dlp -U
    

Users who installed with pip/etc should make sure to include the `[default]` extra when upgrading, e.g.:
    
    
    pip install -U "yt-dlp[default]"
    

The `yt-dlp-ejs` package is already included in the Github release executables and the `default` extra from PyPI. If you have installed yt-dlp **some other way** , then you may need to add this to your command the first time you run the new version:
    
    
    --remote-components ejs:github
    

And so that you actually benefit from the fix, make sure you have a [supported JavaScript runtime installed](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/EJS)

* * *

    --extractor-args "yout…

## Description

[pukkandan](https://github.com/pukkandan)

opened [on May 17, 2022](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766#issue-1238299309)

Issue body actions

Some known common issues. Make sure to always check this before opening issues. **Duplicates of these will be strictly treated as spam!**

**Useful issue tracker filters:**

[[Core Issues]](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3Aenhancement%2Cbug%2Ccore%3Adownloader%2Ccore%3Apost-processor%2Ccore%3Aextractor%2Ccore%3Anetworking%2Ccore%3Acookies) [[Site Issues]](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3Asite-request%2Csite-enhancement%2Csite-bug) [[YouTube issues]](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3Asite%3Ayoutube) [[Good issues for new devs]](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aopen+is%3Aissue+label%3A%22gateway-issue%22)

## Intractable issues

  * **[[YouTube] This content isn't available, try again later. #11426](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11426)**
    * You are exceeding the rate limit. Refer to [the wiki on how to avoid](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Extractors#this-content-isnt-available-try-again-later).
  * **[Passing Youtube cookies doesn't seem to work; cookies are being invalidated quickly #8227](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8227)**
    * [How to effectively export YouTube cookies](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Extractors#exporting-youtube-cookies)
  * **[[youtube] Sign in to confirm you’re not a bot #10128](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10128)**
    * Your IP has been blocked by YouTube while you are logged out. You can [pass logged-in cookies](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/Extractors#exporting-youtube-cookies); however, doing so may get your account blocked. The safer solution is to use a different IP.
    * To prevent this, [try using a PO Token provider](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/PO-Token-Guide), though it will not help if your IP is already blocked.
  * **[[youtube] "Video unavailable" with cookies - YouTube blocking accounts from web #10085](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10085)**
    * Your account has been blocked by YouTube, or the video is not available in your region.
    * Avoid passing cookies, or add a [sleep delay](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#workarounds) to each download.
  * **[[Youtube] Immediate HTTP Error 403 on download #11868](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11868)**
    * Try using `--force-ipv4`, try using yt-dlp from a different IP address (e.g. disable your VPN), try using logged-in cookies if you were using yt-dlp logged-out, or try using yt-dlp without cookies if you were using logged-in cookies

# External issues

  * [ffmpeg can't seek in Youtube's iOS m3u8 streams / `--download-sections` only downloads audio #9552](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/9552)
    * Use `-S proto:https` or `--extractor-args "youtube:player_client=default,-ios"`
  * [`--cookies-from-browser` "Permission denied" errors when Chrome/chromium-based browser is open in Windows #7271](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7271)
    * Try after closing chrome completely OR
    * Launch chrome from command line w/ `chrome.exe --disable-features=LockProfileCookieDatabase`
    * Alternatively, you can [install](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#installing-plugins) the [ChomeCookieUnlock yt-dlp plugin](https://github.com/seproDev/yt-dlp-ChromeCookieUnlock)
  * [`--cookies-from-browser`: WARNING: failed to decrypt with DPAPI / ERROR: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'decode' #10927](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10927)
  * [[youtube] Is downloading a livestream in 1440p or 2160p no longer available? #11262](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11262)
  * [[Youtube] 8k VR180 SBS videos no longer available #9903](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/9903)
    * Use `--extractor-arg "youtube:player_client=android_vr,default"`
  * [[Youtube] throttling and inconsistent speed in Russia #10443](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10443)
    * [Workarounds](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10443#issuecomment-2248940967)
  * [[Discord bot] Music stops in the middle #8854](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8854)
  * [[youtube] Endless "Incomplete data received" when downloading playlist #10394](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10394)
    * Don't use `--extractor-retries infinite`
  * [FFMPEG "Invalid data found when processing input" on live/post-live/dash videos (duplicate ftyp) #8641](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8641)
    * Regression in ffmpeg 6.1. Upgrade to ffmpeg 6.1.1 or to [master build](https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds/releases) revision `N-112916` or later
  * [[youtube] "Invalid data found when processing input" / ffmpeg errors on HDR VP9 in mp4 #7541](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7541)
    * ffmpeg bug. Upgrade to ffmpeg 7.0.1 or to the latest [master build](https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds/releases)
  * [`--mark-watched` fails with urlopen error #8149](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8149)
    * Disable pi-hole or whitelist `s.youtube.com`
  * [Chapter Embedding Results in Unnamed Chapters When Using Recent FFmpeg Builds #6859](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/6859)
    * ffmpeg regression. Use <https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds> or upgrade to 6.1.1 or newer
  * [yt-dlp is detected as a virus #25](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/25)
    * It's a false positive. Complain to your vendor. There is nothing we can do
  * [Incomplete Data Recieved #1787](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1787)
    * Broken from Youtube's side. If downloading comments, use `-i` to ignore the error
  * [Wrong year in metadata in M4A, MP4, FLAC format #3087](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3087)
    * Workaround: `--parse-metadata "%(release_year,upload_date).4s:(?P<meta_date>.+)"`
  * [pyinstaller temp files are not cleaned up when using yt-dlp.exe with mpv #10294](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10294)
  * [Long Start-Up Time for `yt-dlp_macos` #10425](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10425)
  * [`--download-sections` / ffmpeg fails to seek in a 26+ hour long Twitch m3u8 #5372](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5372)
  * [Using proxy and `--download-sections`/ ffmpeg fails with HTTP Error 400/401/403 #12915](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12915)

    * You probably don't have enough free disk space on the drive where your temp dir is located

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Japan

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Most TVer videos can be downloaded without any issues.  
However, specific episodes like the one listed below are failing with the extraction error.

Problem URL:  
<https://tver.jp/episodes/epqr6eo0yk>

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Region

### Example URLs

Hi.

Typing in the format for -f is easy on youtube. Its just 1-2 numbers. But on some sites i got long format names like "hls-1080p". A feature would be nice if the formats table have a first collumn with only 1,2,3 a.s.o. so i have to type only that one key.

I made me a bash script to make this faster and i don't have to re-edit the command and change from -F to -f. Now shorter inputs will be great.

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

`/bin/bash

YOUTUBE_DL_BINARY=/home/XXXX/.local/bin/yt-dlp_linux

VIDEO_URL=$1  
FORMAT_ID=""

[[ -z "$1" ]] && { echo "No Video URL found. Exiting" ; exit 1; }

#First run to get avaliable Video Formats  
$YOUTUBE_DL_BINARY -F "$1" || exit 1

#Read input for -f  
read -p "Enter Video Format ID: " FORMAT_ID

[[ -z "$FORMAT_ID" ]] && { echo "No Video Format found. Exiting" ; exit 1; }

#Download video  
$YOUTUBE_DL_BINARY -f "$FORMAT_ID" "$VIDEO_URL" || exit 1;

exit 0`

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Italy

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

When I try to download a video from PH, also with the latest nightly build of yt-dlp (2026.5.16.233954.dev0), I receive this error:  
“ERROR: [PornHub] 69b7a8e1a6e21: Unable to download webpage: HTTP Error 410: Gone (caused by <HTTPError 410: Gone>)”

I use the latest version of a-Shell mini on iPhone 17 Pro Max.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

United States

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I found that one livestream download keeps unexpectedly ending despite the stream continuing. This has happened on two different live streams from on [this channel](https://www.youtube.com/@courtroom3386) today. When trying to resume, it indicates it was already downloaded, so I have to delete the prematurely completed file for yt-dlp to grab and download it again, only for it to prematurely end again while the live stream keeps broadcasting.

This is currently happening on this video: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=de3STw8r6mo>

I captured debug logs, which are copied below; the download had ended prematurely, and it's still streaming/live at the same URL as I write this.

I download many other live streams from other channels that don't experience this issue, but for some reason, multiple videos on this channel keep downloading early, requiring me to delete the downloaded incomplete file mp4 file and manually download again using the same command.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

Issue body actions

On Rutube, I selected several videos labeled HDR and requested information.

All videos are not HDR, obviously I'm doing something wrong....  
There is no 10‑bit VP9 or HEVC → there is no real HDR stream for download

Is it possible to get HDR or only SDR through yt-dlp?
    
    
    with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL({
        'format': 'bestvideo+bestaudio/best',
        'merge_output_format': 'mp4',
        'outtmpl': os.path.join('/uploads/', f'rutube-{args.video}.%(ext)s'),
        'verbose': True,
        'ignoreerrors': True
    }) as ydl:
        info = ydl.extract_info(f"https://rutube.ru/video/{args.video}/", download=True)

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Bangladesh

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

WARNING: [TikTok] The extractor is attempting impersonation, but no impersonate target is available. If you encounter errors, then see <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#impersonation> for information on installing the required dependencies  
ERROR: unable to download video data: HTTP Error 400: Bad Request

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

# [twitch] FFmpegFixupM3u8PP causes video truncation/compression for long Twitch VODs #15825

[twitch] FFmpegFixupM3u8PP causes video truncation/compression for long Twitch VODs#15825

Copy link

Labels

[incompleteFurther information is needed](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22incomplete%22)Further information is needed[site-bugIssue with a specific website](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22site-bug%22)Issue with a specific website

[](https://github.com/ustclan)

## Description

[](https://github.com/ustclan)

[ustclan](https://github.com/ustclan)

opened [on Feb 4, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15825#issue-3896346637)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Description:  
When downloading long Twitch VODs (2+ hours), the last 30 minutes of video gets compressed into just a few seconds, resulting in black screen for the remainder of the video. The issue is caused by the FFmpegFixupM3u8PP post-processor.

Reproduction Steps:

Download a long Twitch VOD (2+ hours):
    
    
    yt-dlp -f '480p' https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2670757337
    

Play the downloaded video

Observe that the final 30 minutes are either black screen or compressed into just a few seconds of playback

Affected URL:

<https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2670757337>

Root Cause:  
The issue occurs in the FFmpegFixupM3u8PP post-processor when it tries to fix MPEG-TS in MP4 container. The problematic code is in yt_dlp/postprocessor/ffmpeg.py:
    
    
    python
    def run(self, info):
        if all(self._needs_fixup(info)):
            args = ['-f', 'mp4']
            if self.get_audio_codec(info['filepath']) == 'aac':
                args.extend(['-bsf:a', 'aac_adtstoasc'])  # This causes issues
            self._fixup('Fixing MPEG-TS in MP4 container', info['filepath'], [
                *self.stream_copy_opts(), *args])
    

The -bsf:a aac_adtstoasc bitstream filter appears to cause timestamp corruption when processing long MPEG-TS streams, resulting in the final portion of the video being compressed/misaligned.

Expected Behavior:  
The entire video should be preserved with correct timing and duration.

Actual Behavior:  
The last portion (approximately 30 minutes) of long videos gets compressed into a few seconds, showing as black screen.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output

[](https://github.com/pin-grid-array)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

United States

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

All DisneyNow videos fail to download with `HTTP Error 503: Service Unavailable` as the error.

A United States IP address is required to use the entire DisneyNow website.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output

    [debug] Encodings: locale cp1252, fs utf-8, pref cp1252, out utf-8, error utf-8, screen utf-8
    [debug] yt-dlp version stable@2026.03.03 from yt-dlp/yt-dlp [2ecc4c3bc] (win_exe)

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

United States

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Ongoing membership live streams appear on the website under the `/live` tab, but do not appear when trying to download the tab with `yt-dlp`.

Once the stream is complete (not live), it appears normally.  
The stream _does_ appear when giving yt-dlp the `/membership` tab instead.

This is with my main Google/YouTube account, so I am not willing to share the account details in this case, sorry.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

_No response_

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

US

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I am seeing HTTP Error 410: Gone errors for PH urls that are visible in the browser. These urls appeared to work around a week ago.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Australia

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

yt-dlp for newer content on [www.10play.com.au](http://www.10play.com.au) is now longer detecting the presence of subtitles. If watching the video via browser, the subtitles are there but yt-dlp can't detect them. See example below. Let me know if you need more details as I am new to this site and this is my 1st post.

C:\ffmpeg\bin>yt-dlp -u USERNAME -p PASSWORD --list-subs <https://10.com.au/the-cheap-seats/episodes/season-6/episode-2/tpv260428khqtj>

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Brazil

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

yt-dlp seems to have problems parsing video titles that have the `'` character.

Consider, for example, this title here: `My fake stepcousin couldn't help himself (...)`

yt-dlp replaces the character `'` with the sequence `&#039;`

And so the file name becomes `My fake stepcousin couldn&#039;t help himself(...)`

If you use `--embed-metadata`, the bad name will also be added as the video title.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a new site support request
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

USA

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I am unable to download videos hosted on vids.io that require not only a password but also an email address. The Email is then used in a watermark on the web player (along with IP and a GUID).

Trying to download the video with just the URL will say "This video is password-protected; use the --video-password option".

Trying again with the correct password gives the error "Unable to extract any SproutVideo embed url".

I've tried including the cookie from vids.io as well, and that will act like it is downloading the video, but everything is returning 403 Forbidden. I can see it's including the vemail parameter in the URL when the cookies are included.

I've included debug output with just the password as well as debug output when including the cookies. I've redacted my email from the logs for privacy.

I can provide the video password privately.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

United States

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Files downloaded from Spankbang have the video ID where the title should be, for example, "a4gua [a4gua].mp4" instead of "Title [a4gua].mp4"

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a new site support request
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required

  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

### Region

Poland/Europe (Should be available worldwide)

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

**What the problem is ?**  
yt-dlp fails to fetch formats otehr than Preview and 360p even if higher resolution and/or source formats are available:  
`yt-dlp -F` output snippet for a 1080p video with available formats: source (1080p), 540p, 360p, preview:
    
    
    ID      EXT RESOLUTION │ PROTO │ VCODEC  ACODEC
    ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    preview mp4 unknown    │ https │ unknown unknown
    360     mp4 360p       │ https │ unknown unknown
    

**How it could be fixed**  
All available formats should be fetched by yt-dlp, as they were before the sites recent temporary unavailability and recovery.

**How your proposed solution would look like**  
Compare the current and old JSON, fetched by yt-dlp and extract the missing formats.
    
    
    ID      EXT RESOLUTION │ PROTO │ VCODEC  ACODEC
    ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    preview mp4 unknown    │ https │ unknown unknown
    source mp4 1080p    │ https │ unknown unknown
    540      mp4 540p       │ https │ unknown unknown
    360     mp4 360p       │ https │ unknown unknown

## Description

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

When using the argument sponsorblock-remove to remove segments, the video is trimmed correctly but the audio remains. Playing this back results in differing behaviour depending on the video player; VLC mostly handles it well, though the audio skips a bit, but MPC-BE pauses the video stream whilst the audio catches up, resulting in the segment not being skipped at all.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

## Description

[](https://github.com/Fabian42)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

_No response_

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

If a SponsorBlock segment lies outside the video duration (which shouldn't be done, but is apparently possible), yt-dlp creates a file that lasts until the beginning (for some reason not end) of that last segment, causing a long freeze frame after the end of the actual video content, then the last bit of the video gets played at the end of the file.

Example: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jBrcBPXUBFw>  
The video is just 3min29sec long, but someone submitted a segment from 9:52.567 to 11:06.564, so yt-dlp makes a video file that is 9min52sec long, with most if it just showing a static image.  
I have already downvoted the segment, so maybe it gets removed before this report is addressed. In that case, it should be possible to test it by creating a segment, manually entering a timestamp and then submitting it to the SponsorBlock testing server.  
When jumping forwards with VLC into the broken part, it jumps right to the last few seconds, so you have to increase speed to go there instead.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Getting `[Errno 13] Permission denied` when trying to use `--cookies-from-browser` on Firefox (Version 147.0.2 (64-bit)).

Tried both with the browser open and the browser closed, but the same error occurs.

Also tried going to `about:config` and changing `storage.sqlite.exclusiveLock.enabled` to `false` as suggested, but still no luck.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

Copy link

Labels

[blockedFurther work on this is blocked until consensus is reached with the core maintainers](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22blocked%22)Further work on this is blocked until consensus is reached with the core maintainers[bugBug that is not site-specific](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22bug%22)Bug that is not site-specific

[](https://github.com/Suntooth)

## Description

[](https://github.com/Suntooth)

[Suntooth](https://github.com/Suntooth)

opened [on Feb 9, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15902#issue-3914190345)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

`--list-subs` states that it simulates unless `--no-simulate` is passed, and `--force-write-archive` states that it forces a video ID to be written to an archive file if there are no errors even if simulating, but if both are used together, nothing is written to the archive file. `--download-archive` itself works, as it still checks against the archive file to see if it should simulate downloading the video.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

## Description

[](https://github.com/PerchunPak)

[PerchunPak](https://github.com/PerchunPak)

opened [on Mar 23, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16329#issue-4123917675)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

The filter does not seem to work. I've tried `-match-filter aspect_ration=1.78`, `>1.76 & <1.80`, `>1.0 & <2.0`. `aspect_ration` in the `--write-info-json` is 1.78 as expected.  
As far as I undertand, `aspect_ratio` is `round(width/hight, 2)`, so `round(1920 / 1080, 2) == 1.78`
    
    
    yt-dlp 'https://youtu.be/HOrCgBVDWuE' --match-filter "aspect_ratio=1.78"

Also was verified by cactism in Discord  
<https://discord.com/channels/807245652072857610/807247901981016094/1485754422100361359>

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Region

United States

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

**A few videos came out recently talking about how Klingon is a good choice for a second audio track on YouTube, because there are no native speakers.**

<https://youtu.be/NL-IVJi8r3M>  
<https://youtu.be/K5hwBPds3Oo>

**I tried downloading them as alternate tracks, but the language ends up mislabeled in every player and metadata scanner. The issue is not with YouTube itself, as running**

yt-dlp -F '<https://youtu.be/NL-IVJi8r3M>'

**This results in a format list which includes:**

251-0 webm audio only 2 | 2.57MiB 108k https | audio only opus 108k 48k [tlh] Klingon, medium, webm_dash

**This suggests that yt-dlp knows the correct language information. However, if we look at the metadata in the downloaded file using mediainfo:**

Language : Tagalog

**VLC also reports Tagalog, and Plex scans the file as "Filipino"**

**I don't think this is the fault of the players/mediainfo. When I open the MKV file in mkvtoolnix, the headers show "Tagalog (tl; tgl)", and there is an option to modify the metadata and switch to "Klingon (tlh)". So mkvtoolnix supports Klingon, but yt-dlp wrote the file incorrectly.**

**I don't believe this is intended behavior, but if I am wrong, let me know. The command I used to download this file is available with verbose output. I did use YouTube Premium cookies for this.**

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Hey everyone,

I noticed something strange:

When downloading to my home folder, (or any other location) everything works as expected, but when I'm trying to download to my NFS share, the download simply does not start.

Creating/modifying file on the NFS share works without any issue.

## Description

[](https://github.com/VonJagdstrumel)

[VonJagdstrumel](https://github.com/VonJagdstrumel)

opened [on Jan 29, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15753#issue-3871862225)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

When running `yt-dlp` under Cygwin, the `--cookies-from-browser` option fails to locate browser databases (Firefox, Chrome, etc.). This is because Cygwin's `os.path.expandvars` implementation follows POSIX conventions (expecting `$VARIABLE`) rather than Windows conventions (expecting `%VARIABLE%`).

Currently, `yt_dlp/cookies.py` uses hardcoded `%APPDATA%` and `%LOCALAPPDATA%` strings when `sys.platform` is `cygwin`, resulting in literal strings that fail to expand and cause a `FileNotFoundError`.

Here is a short demonstration :
    
    
    Python 3.12.12 (main, Oct 11 2025, 11:03:47) [GCC 13.4.0] on cygwin
    Type "help", "copyright", "credits" or "license" for more information.
    >>> import os, sys
    >>> sys.platform
    'cygwin'
    >>> os.name
    'posix'
    >>> os.path.expandvars('%APPDATA%\\Mozilla\\Firefox\\Profiles')
    '%APPDATA%\\Mozilla\\Firefox\\Profiles'
    >>> os.path.expandvars('$APPDATA\\Mozilla\\Firefox\\Profiles')
    'C:\\Users\\Steve\\AppData\\Roaming\\Mozilla\\Firefox\\Profiles'
    >>>
    

A possible fix involves checking the platform and using the appropriate variable expansion syntax for both Firefox and Chromium-based browser path logic.

I have prepared a patch ([`master...VonJagdstrumel:yt-dlp:cygwin/cookies-expandvars`](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/compare/master...VonJagdstrumel:yt-dlp:cygwin/cookies-expandvars)) that:

  1. Uses `$VAR` syntax for Cygwin and `%VAR%` for native Win32.
  2. Uses `os.path.join` to build paths cleanly once the root environment variables are resolved.



### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

## Description

[](https://github.com/Dark-Sider)

[Dark-Sider](https://github.com/Dark-Sider)

opened [on May 16, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16741#issue-4461251354)

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Until now I was yousing the yt-dlp CLI version to save some videos via a python script. I thought it was more elegant to fall back to the pip-api version. However using the same ffmpeg version on the same machine with the same options yt-dlp pip-api version only submits the video and not the audio stream to ffmpeg, resulting in a video with no audio.

There are the debug logs of both CLI and API in the box below. Both logs are truncated where ffmpeg gets invoked, as it is clearly visible that with API only the video stream gets passed on.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

when using the `--paths` options to set the `home` and `temp` directories, if the `temp` directory is set to a `tmpfs` mounted filesystem (RAM drive, for example) at the end of the process, the cleanup of the temporary file is left behind with what appears to be a permissions error

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output
    
    
    [debug] Command-line config: ['https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rDvXAr7j7Bk', '--paths', 'home:/downloads', '--paths', 'temp:/tmp', '-vU']
    [debug] Encodings: locale UTF-8, fs utf-8, pref UTF-8, out utf-8, error utf-8, screen utf-8
    [debug] yt-dlp version stable@2025.12.08 from yt-dlp/yt-dlp [7a52ff29d] (pip)

  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates

  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

postprocess with --skip-download#9695

Copy link

Labels

[questionQuestion](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22question%22)Question

[](https://github.com/gwttk)

## Description

[](https://github.com/gwttk)

[gwttk](https://github.com/gwttk)

opened [on Apr 16, 2024](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/9695#issue-2245055153)

Issue body actions

### DO NOT REMOVE OR SKIP THE ISSUE TEMPLATE

  * I understand that I will be **blocked** if I _intentionally_ remove or skip any mandatory* field



### Checklist

  * I'm asking a question and **not** reporting a bug or requesting a feature
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766) and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=) for similar questions **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [guidelines for opening an issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#opening-an-issue)



### Please make sure the question is worded well enough to be understood

Ok so first, `--write-subs --use-postprocessor "subs_converter" --print "after_move:%(requested_subtitles.:.filepath)s"` works fine.  
But let's skip download cuz we are just for subs. `--write-subs --use-postprocessor "subs_converter" --print "after_move:%(requested_subtitles.:.filepath)s" --skip-download`.  
No print no postprocess.  
So I tried before_dl. `--write-subs --use-postprocessor "subs_converter:when=before_dl" --print "before_dl:%(requested_subtitles.:.filepath)s" --skip-download`. Sub is converted but the print happened before the postprocess so the output is wrong.  
But if I move the print to post_process it won't print `--write-subs --use-postprocessor "subs_converter:when=before_dl" --print "post_process:%(requested_subtitles.:.filepath)s" --skip-download`  
Now... what should I do, to download subs only and call the postprocessor and print the converted filename?  
Is there a stage between before_dl and post_process so I can print the result after the postprocess?

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

# Having yt-dlp create a symlink for playlists with a certain path #13674

New issue

Copy link

New issue

Copy link

Open

Open

Having yt-dlp create a symlink for playlists with a certain path#13674

Copy link

Labels

[questionQuestion](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22question%22)Question

[](https://github.com/Aces-and-Jacks)

## Description

[](https://github.com/Aces-and-Jacks)

[Aces-and-Jacks](https://github.com/Aces-and-Jacks)

opened [on Jul 9, 2025](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/13674#issue-3214340349)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm asking a question and **not** reporting a bug or requesting a feature
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar questions **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates



### Please make sure the question is worded well enough to be understood

As far as I can see, no one has posted a question like this. I know you can use the `--exec` command for symlinks. But I'm not really code savy to figure this out. This probably isn't possible but I figured it wouldn't hurt to ask.

I currently have the videos I download symlinked as `--exec 'cd "/Users/$USER/Downloads/sym-folder" && ln -s --'`. Which worked well before. All my videoes get downloaded to their own folders as `/Users/$USER/YT-Downloads/%(uploader)s-[%(uploader_id)s]/%(uploader)s-%(upload_date>%Y-%m-%d)s_%(title)s-[%(id)s]/%(uploader)s-%(upload_date)s_%(title)s-[%(id)s].%(ext)s'` and the resulting files get symlinked to the other directory.

The thing is when I download a playlist, a folder that shows the playlist uploader gets created along with the other uploads for each video `%(uploader)s-[%(uploader_id)s]`. Which I'm fine with (I also see in the info file the playlist name and count it was with), but for the symlinked videos they just show without any filepath order. Which would make sense based on the file path. I tried using one of the fields in the OUTPUT TEMPLATE options but that didn't work properly. I figured it probably wouldn't tho.

I had asked for help for just symlinking in the past in [#11080](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11080) and based on what `bashonly` provided I tried to figure it out. He mentioned there was a field for `filepath` but I guess I had asked too many questions since he didn't answer, and I had already gotten my main question at the time answered. For symlinking he meantioned

> `ln -s -- %(filepath,_filename|)q`

but then said

> IMPORTANT: you should only ever use `%()q` in `--exec` arguments, and never `%()s`

So to sum it all up, I was wondering about a command that creates symlinks in a filepath that includes the playlist uploader. Like some sort of field string or something. I hope I didn't make this too confusing.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output

Extractors: Availability of DOM query functions#10621

Copy link

Labels

[questionQuestion](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22question%22)Question

[](https://github.com/Lalufu)

## Description

[](https://github.com/Lalufu)

[Lalufu](https://github.com/Lalufu)

opened [on Aug 1, 2024](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10621#issue-2442230799)

Issue body actions

### DO NOT REMOVE OR SKIP THE ISSUE TEMPLATE

  * I understand that I will be **blocked** if I _intentionally_ remove or skip any mandatory* field



### Checklist

  * I'm asking a question and **not** reporting a bug or requesting a feature
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766) and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=) for similar questions **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [guidelines for opening an issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#opening-an-issue)



### Please make sure the question is worded well enough to be understood

I am looking into writing a new extractor, and I'm wondering if I'm missing some obvious utility functions for extracting information from a HTML page. I had, maybe naively, expected there to be functions similar to `document.querySelector()` and `document.querySelectorAll()` from JS, which take a more or less abstract path through the document and return matching elements, maybe backed by `BeautifulSoup` or other libraries. I have found the `get_element_*` functions from `utils`, which don't seem to quite do the same thing (I can't seem to look for tags of a certain type?), and looking at other extractors, using regular expressions seems to be pretty popular for some reason instead. There's also some xpath support, but from a quick look nothing seems to utilize this for dealing with HTML.  
Do functions like this exist, and I haven't found them, or is this a discouraged approach for some reason?

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

# yt-dlp overwrite final file #13381
